subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Should production GitHub authentication be transferred to or replaced by an OAuth application under official OpenClaw organizational custody now?
rationale: Only an authorized production and GitHub-organization owner can choose the official custodian, transfer or create the application, rotate its secret, and verify the live security boundary.

options.title: Rotate to official ownership
options.body: Transfer or create an officially owned ClawHub OAuth application, rotate production credentials, and close only after redacted live web and CLI consent proof.

options.title: Temporarily retain personal custody
options.body: Explicitly accept the existing personal application as a temporary production dependency and document its owner, access controls, and planned migration date.

recommendation.title: Rotate to official ownership
recommendation.body: Transfer or create an officially owned ClawHub OAuth application, rotate production credentials, and close only after redacted live web and CLI consent proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This account was assigned the earlier operational report and is the strongest available routing signal for coordinating the production change.
